description.from:
Ryan, 2026-10-17 portfolio review: the anth.us contact path is a Google Form, which undercuts the Prospectus pitch. The engage page gets an inline inquiry form that posts to Prospectus intake (Prospectus kanbus-47dc15ae). The form appears only when GATSBY_PROSPECTUS_INTAKE_URL is set for the build; until then the page keeps the Google Form link, so nothing changes in production before Prospectus real-contact intake is deployed.

Feature: Engagement inquiries reach Prospectus
  Scenario: Intake configured
    Given GATSBY_PROSPECTUS_INTAKE_URL points at Prospectus intake
    When a visitor sends the engage form
    Then they see a receipt and the inquiry lands in Prospectus
  Scenario: Intake not configured
    Given no intake URL
    Then the page keeps the existing contact link
description.to:
## Current goal and status (2026-10-17)

As an anth.us visitor, I want to send an engagement inquiry to the actual production inbox and receive a confirmed receipt, while the existing contact path stays usable during rollout.

Production website code belongs to AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus **main**, not this superseded Gatsby repository. Gatsby PR83 shipped only to historical Amplify d1ffh6ny5rvtl. Public anth.us is S3 projection behind CloudFront E3UMOOJRMY7FK7, with CMS/backend deployment from d7s858igkyct5 in papyrus-production account 712236451410.

The inquiry port is merged in Anth.us-Papyrus PR52/54. The actual renderer reads bundled web/inquiry-config.json; GATSBY_PROSPECTUS_INTAKE_URL does not configure it. Configuration is intentionally disabled. The Google Form remains available.

**Blocked upstream:** Prospectus main 1864ef3cf5ab has evaluation-deployment.json enabled=false, mode=synthetic-only, approval="Pending concrete evaluation runtime and access review". Prospectus activation PR19 is OPEN at 76f5eb47 with green CI. That PR describes prior approval, but its merge/deployment is outside this Anth.us-only exception. Its description says main auto-build is off, so activation also requires its separately authorized pipeline job. After approved real-contact deployment, verify the endpoint/CORS and supply the endpoint plus approved notice/version in a scoped Anth.us-Papyrus PR. Do not report the disabled form as a completed live intake.

Feature: Engagement inquiries on the production Papyrus website
  Scenario: Approved real-contact intake configured
    Given the bundled production configuration contains an approved HTTPS endpoint and notice
    When a visitor sends an inquiry
    Then the visitor sees success only after a server receipt
    And retries reuse the submission ID until the inquiry changes
    And no credentials or marketing enrollment are sent
  Scenario: Upstream intake remains gated
    Given production inquiry configuration is disabled
    When a visitor opens /engage/
    Then the existing public Google Form remains available
    And no inline form claims it can receive real inquiries

Child kanbus-0d24 records the scoped ownership correction, tests, deployment, and recoverable M1 clone retirement. Detailed receipts are in the comments.
